briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and Google Gemini 3 escalate multi-agent reasoning race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs push scaling boundaries with new reasoning models while regulatory scrutiny intensifies. Funding remains robust amid infrastructure buildouts. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation gains traction in security discussions.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released Orion-2 with 20% gains on agentic benchmarks. Anthropic's Claude 4 and Meta's Llama 4.1 compete closely. DeepSeek-V3 and xAI Grok-3 advance open-weight capabilities. Google DeepMind integrates real-time multi-agent orchestration in Gemini 3.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins with fines for non-compliant models.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 500k units monthly. Microsoft and Amazon announce $40B combined data center expansions. TSMC 2nm yields improve for AI accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first ASI-level system emerge from a US lab or a Chinese consortium by 2028?
